description: Read the owner's accounting connection/setup state, selected organization/company/business, rollout state and one connect/reconnect setupUrl. Pass an existing reportId to open that exact report's provider setup control; otherwise general Reports setup. Never posts data. Agent posting supports only Zoho Books (zoho_books). QuickBooks Online (quickbooks), Xero (xero), Wave (wave) and FreeAgent (freeagent, beta) support connection/status only with writesAuthorized=false until shared canonical planning is available.

provider.description: Accounting destination provider. QuickBooks Online, Xero, Wave, FreeAgent (beta), or Zoho Books.

reportId.description: Optional existing ExpenseBot report ID. When supplied, setupUrl opens this exact report and highlights the selected accounting provider's setup control.

name: get_accounting_integration_status
